name: Input

representativeVariants.name: Default — outlined
representativeVariants.whySelected: No visible form field appeared on the homepage, so the default follows the site's observed 1px/2px rule language and typography stack.

representativeVariants.name: Focus — active
representativeVariants.whySelected: Focus needs to remain high-contrast without introducing a new brand hue; the existing black ring is the source-aligned emphasis.

representativeVariants.name: Muted — filter
representativeVariants.whySelected: A muted surface is appropriate for tag or archive filters while preserving the square field silhouette.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use for archive search and content filtering; keep the field visually subordinate to the article and project cards.
usageHints.a11y: Every field needs a visible label or aria-label, a focus indicator, and an associated error message when invalid.

unknowns: The public homepage exposes no visible input or search field; field height and focus treatment are reusable inferences from the observed token system.
